programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Long before the first funeral home was established in Manchester, Kentucky in 1938, there was the Chestnut House. The Chestnut family dedicated one of the home’s parlors to store the caskets they made.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Paranormal enthusiasts have theorized that Somerset County’s enthralling paranormal finds may have more to do with the geomagnetic anomalies present in its unique land that yield results which are fascinating to some and terrifying to others.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Roddy Piper
programme.desc: "Rowdy" Roddy Piper (legendary WWE wrestler) is paid a visit by Kim at his home in Portland, Oregon as he seeks answers to the ghost experiences.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Giancarlo Esposito
programme.desc: Giancarlo Esposito (Breaking Bad / Revolution / The Usual Suspects) tells the story of his former home in Ridgefield, CT.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye gutten i klassen overtaler Jesus til å kjempe mot Satan, i det endelige oppgjøret mellom godt og ondt. Cartman blir rasende når han oppdager at oppgjøret krasjer med bursdagsfesten hans.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er en hore
programme.desc: Dr. Mephisto hjelper Cartman med å avsløre farens identitet, og alle mannlige innbyggere i South Park er aktuelle kandidater.

programme.title: South Park: Byen ved avgrunnens rand (tilbakeblikk)
programme.desc: Skolebussen krasjer i en snøstorm og blir stående på kanten av et stup.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer nabolaget
programme.desc: Token føler seg ensom fordi han er eneste rike barn i byen, og lokker andre velstående mennesker til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmtraileren
programme.desc: Alle barna i South Park er superspente på å se den første traileren for den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmen.

programme.title: South Park: Barneskolemusikal
programme.desc: Musikalfeberen når South Park, og guttene må spille med eller miste popularitet.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskepikker
programme.desc: Jimmi er rasende for at Cartmann prøver å ta æren for en vits som han fant på og som nå er blitt populær i hele landet. Men en sint Kanye West klarer ikke å forstå poenget.

programme.title: South Park: Tiss
programme.desc: Høyt urininnhold i svømmebassenget fører til en katastrofe som ødelegger guttas dag, særlig Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får fritt utløp igjen.

programme.title: South Park: Broadway-brødrene
programme.desc: Når Randy forstår hemmeligheten bak musikaler, kan han ikke slutte med å ta med seg Sharon for å se dem. Andrew Lloyd-Webber og Elton John advarer ham mot å avsløre deres hemmelighet.

programme.title: South Park: Butter slår tilbake
programme.desc: Butters blir i hemmelighet plaget av sin bestemor og Stan ønsker å øke bevisstheten om farene ved mobbing. Stans idé er å spille inn en stor dansevideo, men suksessen raskt går til hodet på ham.

programme.title: South Park: Glutenfri ebola
programme.desc: South Park blir glutenfritt.

programme.title: South Park: Pre-CIS
programme.desc: Ifølge Eric Cartman har Wendy Testaburger blitt lesbisk.

programme.title: South Park: Du yelper ikke til
programme.desc: Cartman ser seg som den beste restaurantkritikeren på nettet i South Park.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nesten tjue år etter at kult-serien Galaxy Quest ble kansellert, ber romvesener besetningen om hjelp til å redde universet.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: I 2009 oppdaget NASA muligheten for fremmed liv innenfor vårt solsystem. En sonde ble skutt opp for å samle inn prøver fra en av Jupiters måner, Europa, men krasjet på tilbaketuren over Mellom-Amerika.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Den dyktige advokaten Casey McKay blir hentet ut til en liten by av sin ekskone for å forsvare broren, anklaget for å ha drept en lovmann. Han oppdager et nett av intriger der han ender ansikt til ansikt med byens mest korrupte entreprenør, Mr. Gates.

programme.title: Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Da Terry Wolfmeyers (Joan Allen) mann plutselig en dag forlater henne og deres fire døtre uten så mye som et ord til farvel, snus tilværelsen for den vellykkede forstadsfamilien fullstendig på hodet!

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy er et superpopulært nyhetsanker i 1970-årenes San Diego som mener at kvinner kan pynte opp et nyhetsrom. Så når Ron får vite han skal jobbe med en smart, vakker ung dame som mestrer mer enn å være til pynt, blir det krig!

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Eks-agenten Bryan Mills er forsont med sin tidligere kone, men lykken blir kortvarig når hun brutalt myrdes og han blir beskyldt for udåden.

programme.title: Wagons East
programme.desc: De var ute etter gull, men nå tar de til takke med innlagt vann. John Candy og Richard Lewis spiller i dette hysterisk ukonvensjonelle blikket på den legendariske ville vesten.

programme.title: Frøkens Kjæledegge
programme.desc: Clark Gable plays Jim Gannon, a school-of-hard-knocks newspaperman who despises journalism schools, until he sees who's doing the teaching.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: Mens Sydney holder foredrag om indianerne som møtte en mystisk katastrofe 600 år tidligere, gir en innfødt henne en relikvie fra den tiden. Hva er hemmeligheten?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Hunting with the Enemy
programme.desc: En urn bestilt i et kambodsjansk kloster av den kinesiske keiseren for restene av Confucius er i ferd med å bli ødelagt av den systematiske bombingen av en hel provins.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Under the Ice
programme.desc: Til tross for forferdelig vær, drar Sidney Nigel med til en arktisk base hvor en gammel indisk mamma er funnet, som viser seg å være en Anasazi.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel reiser til Istanbul for å undersøke dødsfallet til en av Sydneys venner, en professor som prøvde å bevise at Hercules eksisterte ved å finne Hippolytebeltet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himmelhvelvet
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer som tilsier ham til en planet med 'ild og is'.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Family Grave and Deception
programme.desc: A man's childhood fears come to life when he returns to his family's farm after his mother's death. A woman begins to suspect that her withdrawn husband may be causing the unexplainable occurrences in their new home.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Attic and 'Til Death
programme.desc: A college student is tormented by her little sister's imaginary friend. A newly engaged woman sees visions of her fiance's widow.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Pest House and Sleepwalkers
programme.desc: An earthquake triggers terrifying activity in a house with a dark past. A young woman sees visions in her sleep that lead her to an abandoned hospital.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Whispering and Ethel
programme.desc: After returning home for her mother's funeral, a young woman is terrorized by visions from her past. A musician finds a suicide note that reveals the dark history of his new house.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Charisma Carpenter

programme.title: The Ape

programme.desc: När den amerikanska poeten Elizabeth Bishop drabbas av skrivkramp i början av 1950-talet bestämmer hon sig för att resa till Brasilien. Där träffar Elizabeth arkitekten Lota de Macedo Soares och de blir snart attraherade av varandra.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When law enforcement officers become targets, no one is safe. So when a crystal meth dealer on the run from the law began shooting cops, it took more than police to stop him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States. Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En erfaren lönnmördare får problem när han blir kär i sitt mål, en charmig svindlare som inte tänker gå ner utan en fight.

programme.desc: Rick the Citizens' Patrolman one-ups the Sheriff's Department in investigating a crime spree, and Garcia receives a visit from an old, unpredictable friend.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Spanish Mike Comes Back
programme.desc: Spanish Mike Alvarez returns to tempt the deputies, and Jones and Garcia work security at a Ted Nugent concert.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Son of a Chechekevitch
programme.desc: The deputies vow to avenge Sheriff Chechekevitch's death, and Wiegel studies with Lamaze instructor Guy Gerricault.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Investigation Continues
programme.desc: The investigation into Sheriff Chechekevitch's murder zeroes in on his ex-wife, and Williams and Wiegel attend a Lamaze class.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Corporate Sponsor
programme.desc: Hotty's Restaurants sponsors the Reno Sheriff's Department, and the gang gets burned by the deal.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Christian Karaoke Singles' Mixer
programme.desc: Clemmy scandalizes Kimball's Christian singles karaoke club, and Dangle takes bets on the origins of Wiegel's baby.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Proposition C
programme.desc: As Williams and Wiegel consider tampering with the vote for deputies' raises, Jones and Garcia tangle with a drug dealer who may be a D.E.A. agent.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Reno Mounties
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia discover that not just anyone can dispense justice from horseback.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton
programme.desc: A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Showdown with Rance McGrew
programme.desc: Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he "wins" against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Hunt
programme.desc: On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
programme.desc: In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Static
programme.desc: An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
programme.desc: Paranoia strikes the residents of Maple Street when they believe human-looking aliens have invaded the neighborhood.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard
programme.desc: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.

programme.title: South Park: Tegridy Farms Halloween Special
programme.desc: Det är Halloween och Randy hanterar sin dotters marijuanaproblem.

programme.title: South Park: Ögoninflammation
programme.desc: Det är Halloween i South Park och Kenny dödas av en fallande rymdstation och omvandlas till en zombie av en balsamerande vätska som är förgiftad med Worcester-sås.

programme.title: South Park: Världens största as
programme.desc: Efter att Cartman druckit Kennys aska och uppfyllts av hans själ känner hans sig inte riktigt bra och måste tas till sjukhuset.

programme.title: South Park: Helvetet på jorden 2006
programme.desc: Det är Halloween och Satan anordnar världens största maskerad.

programme.title: South Park: De levande hemlösas natt
programme.desc: När South Park översvämmas av hemlösa människor tänker pojkarna ut en listig plan för att flytta dem till en annan stad medan de vuxna får panik.

programme.title: South Park: Den ostoppbare
programme.desc: Den för evigt oskyldige Butters är trött på hur han behandlas av sina föräldrar och anammar den nya vampyrfebern lite väl entusiastiskt.

programme.title: South Park: Döda kändisar
programme.desc: Ike plågas av övernaturliga krafter, så Kyle anlitar professionella spökjägare för att rädda sin lillebror.

programme.title: South Park: Zimmermans världskrig
programme.desc: Cartman anser Token vara ett hot mot hela mänskligheten.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman och Kyle blir osams om en magisk triangel de hittar under en arkeologisk utgrävning. Triangeln har kraften att omvandla Barbra Streisand till ett otäckt monster.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Eric Dickerson
programme.desc: NFL great, Eric Dickerson fears that there are spirits in his Calabasas, California home tormenting his children.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kevin Sorbo
programme.desc: Legendary actor, Kevin Sorbo returns to an idyllic lake in Texas where he encountered a ghostly apparition so disturbing it haunts him to this day.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Eric Balfour
programme.desc: Actor and musician, Eric Balfour, returns to a notoriously haunted abandoned hotel in rural Texas where he and friends were attacked and driven out by paranormal forces.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A winding system of caves makes Kentucky one of the most unique geological wonders in the world. Near the caves is Bethlehem Academy, a long-abandoned Catholic School that is being kept alive by a unique resident.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Situated near Kentucky's famous Mammoth Caves, the Grand Victorian Inn has carried the hopes of several businesses, residents, educators, and children since it was first erected in 1885. Now, its current owners have experienced a litany of ghostly claims.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Jimmy och Timmy tror att ett gäng som kallas The Crips är en klubb för handikappade människor och blir medlemmar.

programme.title: South Park: Fetröv och pannkakshuvud
programme.desc: Cartman gör en fingerdocka som liknar J-Lo inför ett multikulturellt evenemang som hyllar latinamerikaner.

programme.title: South Park: Korkad, bortskämd hora-leksaken
programme.desc: Paris Hilton öppnar en butik i South Park och fördärvar samtidigt flickornas moral. Endast Wendy håller fast vid gamla normer.

programme.title: South Park: Agenturen
programme.desc: Som talangmanager kan Cartman, Stan och Kenny ta 10 % av sina kunders förtjänster. Men efter att de idogt har försökt att imponera på sin enda kund stjäls han av en annan manager.

programme.title: South Park: En miljon små fibrer
programme.desc: Towelie skriver en bok och den väljs ut till Oprahs bokklubb. Den blir en bästsäljare för människor som vill bli fria från sina beroenden.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med tvåan i pissoaren
programme.desc: Cartman tror att han vet vem som var hjärnan bakom 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: Momben
programme.desc: South Parks invånare gör sig redo för Hillary Clintons besök. Cartman misstänker att en ny muslimsk elev är inblandad i en eventuell terroristattack.

programme.title: South Park: Mer skitproblem
programme.desc: Randy bryter rekordet för 'världens största bajskorv'. Bono, den förra rekordhållaren, är fast besluten att återta sin krona. Men han har en mörk hemlighet som kan stoppa honom.

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nya look
programme.desc: Mediecirkusen anländer till South Park när Britney gömmer sig i den avlägsna bergsstaden. Pojkarna försöker hjälpa den deprimerade popstjärnan.

programme.title: South Park: Världens största blockflöjtskonsert
programme.desc: Klassen besöker Mr Garrisons hemstad i Arkansas för att gå på en konsert där de försöker hitta det mystiska "bruna ljudet".

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Pojkarna härmar Timmy, som har ADD, för att slippa göra sina läxor.

programme.title: South Park: Nåt du kan göra med fingret
programme.desc: 'Fingerbang' är det senaste pojkbandet med de fyra pojkarna och de får en spelning i ett stort shoppingcenter.

programme.title: South Park: Musikalen Helen Keller!
programme.desc: Pojkarna skapar en egen version av berättelsen om Helen Keller för att överglänsa dagisets uppsättning.

programme.title: South Park: En stege till himlen
programme.desc: Pojkarna bryter in i McCormicks hus och stjäl urnan med Kennys aska.

programme.title: South Park: Fetröv och pannkakshuvud
programme.desc: Cartman gör en fingerdocka som liknar J-Lo inför ett multikulturellt evenemang som hyllar latinamerikaner.

programme.title: South Park: Kristna rockar fett
programme.desc: Cartman är fast besluten att spela in en platinaskiva med sitt nya kristna rockband Faith+1.

programme.title: South Park: Kul med kampsportvapen
programme.desc: Efter att pojkarna köpt kampsportsvapen på en lokal loppmarknad förvandlas de till animerade japanska krigare vilket får förödande konsekvenser för Butters.

programme.title: South Park: Dö, hippie, dö
programme.desc: Cartman arresteras för att fängsla hippies, men när South Park översvämmas av hippies vänder sig staden till honom och han oortodoxa metoder för att bli av med hippiesarna.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: En ung kvinna verkar vara den enda överlevaren efter ett kärnvapenkrig, och hon lever på egen hand, helt utan någon omkring sig. Men en dag får hon syn på den största överraskningen i sitt liv: en annan människa.

programme.title: What Maisie Knew
programme.desc: Wallace har precis blivit bedragen av sitt livs kärlek när han träffar Chantry. När Chantrys pojkvän Ben tvingas flytta i jobbet kommer Wallace och Chantry närmare varandra och Wallace överväger att berätta för Chantry hur han verkligen känner.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady har bott i Afrika och vet inte hur 'vilt' det kan vara i civilisationen förrän hon möter en av världens elakaste arter, 'bidrottningen', som på den här skolan är den coola och beräknande Regina George.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Striden börjar när den heroiska Leonidas, endast beväpnad med läderunderkläder och en bortkastad mantel, leder en brokig skara på 13 (ja, 13!) krigare för att försvara sitt hemland.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: När en person förlorar sin identitet, råkar Slevin hamna i en konflikt mellan två av stadens största brottslingar och han övervakas nu av både polisen och den ökände yrkesmördaren Goodkat.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En tjuv med en unik kod för yrkesetik blir lurad av sitt gäng och lämnas för att dö. Genom att anta ny förklädnad och bilda en otippad allians med en kvinna på insidan kapar han deras senaste kupp.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: När en amerikansk stad invaderas av nordkoreanska soldater, går en grupp ungdomar tillsammans för att skydda varandra, befria staden och återta sin frihet.

programme.title: Ruskiga Rekryter - In war with the army
programme.desc: Alvin (Jerry Lewis) och Vic (Dean Martin) är kompisar som söker värvning i armén, främst därför att Vic har problem med sin flickvän och söker sig via det militära till en tjänstgöring i Europa.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Den sista av Mochicas
programme.desc: På jakt efter en sydamerikansk mochica-indianerrelik som ska skyddas blir Nigel och hans kollegor tillfångatagna av lokala gerillasoldater. Det är upp till Sydney och hans allierade Jason Clark att rädda dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Legenden om de försvunna
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel ger sig ut för att ta reda på om legenden om den förlorade civilisationen på Nya Guinea verkligen är sann. Tyvärr måste de samarbeta med Derek Lloyd.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Bördig jord
programme.desc: Sydney återförenas med sin high school-kärlek för att hitta en hawaiiansk fruktbarhetsidol i Madagaskar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Zigenare Sticksåg
programme.desc: Sydney får en kortlek med sällsynta tarotkort från sin nyligen avlidna vän. Den ökända, tidigare oomnämnda Vulture var ute efter honom. Sydney ber Claudia om hjälp.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Kevlar for Her

programme.title: RENO 911!: Mayor Hernandez

programme.title: RENO 911!: Back in Black

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Odyssey of Flight 33

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Bewitchin' Pool

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: It's a Good Life

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: 100 Yards over the Rim
programme.desc: A pioneer from a wagon train in 1847 sets off to find something for his ill son and stumbles into present-day New Mexico.

programme.title: South Park: Regnskog bängskog
programme.desc: Pojkarna skickas till Costa Ricas regnskog som en del av kören Getting Gay With Kids turné.

programme.title: South Park: Glödhet katolsk kärlek

programme.title: South Park: Pandemin
programme.desc: South Park börjar likna Cloverfield när Randy visar dem skakiga inspelningar han gjort med sin videokamera av en stor mystisk varelse som härjar jorden runt.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemin II: Marsvinigt
programme.desc: Enorma marsvin anfaller städer runt om i världen. Pojkarna har nyckeln som kan rädda mänskligheten, men de sitter fast i Anderna.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reser sig

programme.title: South Park: Coon mot Coon och vänner

programme.title: South Park: Den fattigaste
programme.desc: Kennys föräldrar grips av polisen och han hamnar i ett fosterhem - vilket gör Cartman till skolans fattigaste elev! Samtidigt återvänder en mystisk maskerad superhjälte från det förflutna.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey, julbajskorven

programme.title: South Park: Läskiga fisken

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Ticks
programme.desc: In 2012, a meteorite collides with Earth, unleashing an ecological catastrophe that destroys civilization and tosses the planet into a bleak ice age. There are pockets of survivors, however, spread across the snowy planet. Among them is Capt. Tom Parker (Dean Cain), former head of security at the U.S. Embassy in Berlin, and his second-in-command, Sarah Henley (Joanna Taylor), who lead a team of scientists on an expedition into Europe to find whatever survivors there may be.

There are pockets of survivors, however, spread across the snowy planet. Among them is Capt. Tom Parker (Dean Cain), former head of security at the U.S. Embassy in Berlin, and his second-in-command, Sarah Henley (Joanna Taylor), who lead a team of scientists on an expedition into Europe to find whatever survivors there may be.

programme.title: Don Friesen
programme.desc: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he's fun. His wife thinks he's an idiot. Audiences think he's hilarious! Don is a modern suburban dad just trying to raise his kids and get through the day with a bit of money in the bank and a scrap of dignity intact. With a unique style that can best be described as frenetic and engaging, Don captures the irony of parenting, marriage and everyday absurdities through characters, voices, parodies and some of the best written routines around. He's a wanna-be geek who constantly upgrades to the latest technology, but can never get it to work, leading to signature bits about tech support, Idiots Guides, texting and passwords. Friesen has recently taken his smart, savvy, and highly-caffeinated comedy to the stage at the Alex Theatre in Glendale, CA, for the taping of his new Showtime one-hour special titled "Ask Your Mom." In his first nationally released concert special, Don delivers a winning hour of clever, true-to-life "he's talking about my family up there" comedy that manages to be adult-smart yet family-friendly.

Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse

Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.desc: Fearing for their safety after a public gun mishap/bloodbath, the CFO hires look-a-likes of Dethklok to make public appearances while the band prepares for a Duncan Hills Coffee promotional event.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When promoting a new clothing line, Dethklok experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dr. Rockzo, the Rock n Roll Clown, gets help from Dethklok to overcome his cocaine addition and come c-c-c-clean!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Metal meets mid-west etiquette when Pickles' brother, Seth, invites Dethklok to his Wisconsin wedding.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles' popularity soars when he gets a personal P.R. agent, prompting the rest of Dethklok to form a rival P.R. firm. Meanwhile, Pickles' P.R. woman has dark, otherworldy, and religious motives behind her Evil Press Releases.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Nathan Explosion serves an emergency term as temporary governor for the state of Florida, sending Florida into a state of further emergency.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. Will they spend everything and sign a deal that will render them powerless? Or worse, will they allow Murderface to turn the living room into an Arizona-styled sandscape?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. After home remedies including drinking bleach, Dethklok learns that their ultimate fear will be realized, one of them has a terminal illness. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. Meanwhile Murderface ringleads the ultimate Christmas special that ends up being backed by the Christian church. And a particular ROCK AND ROLL clown makes a holiday appearance. Part of season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After an onslaught of paternity suits, Skwisgaar realizes he will never change until he quits the band to find his father who abandoned him before birth.Meanwhile, Dethklok realizes they all have father abandonment issues and Murderface decides to repair the damages by appointing himself "Band Father."

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki falls head over heals for a girl he meets online. When things sour he tries to break it off and instead has to bear the brutality of being her date at her father's vegan funeral in 110 degree heat. Meanwhile Nathan experiences the brutality of dating a performance artist. And Murderface must attend a sexual harassment seminar after trying to match Skwisgaar's sexual prowess.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface wants the easy life but still wants all the rewards. After the band decides to kick him out for making their jobs more difficult, Murderface realizes the EASIEST way to make BIG money is to start his own label.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Drunk driving HOVER DRUMS and causing billions in damage Pickles the drummer is thrown into rehab and his worst nightmares are realized when he is replaced- by a drum machine.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to turn the life of his rock-and-roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clown's darkest secret.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While Dethklok's manager, Charles Offdensen, is absent cleaning up hundreds of problems caused by the band, Dethklok double books a gig--between Syria and Israel on the same day.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Despite his bandmates' warnings, Nathan begins seriously dating one of his fans. But as the evidence of her past piles up, to prove her innocence, he follows her to the most brutal place on earth: Klokikon - the annual Dethklok fan convention filled with cosplay geeks and homosexual fan art. Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Dethklok is accused of being racist at a huge press conference, they combat the charges by opening an Urban Youth Dethcenter. Meanwhile, Toki, after being left behind, starts a special club that promotes equality and love but excludes Murderface because he doesn't have the right look.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: With their new album finally shipping, Dethklok plans their post-release traditions of vacationing, goofing off, palling around, and prank calls. Nathan, however, can't shake the feeling that something is wrong with the record... After being humiliated by Murderface's prank calls, Skwisgaar and Toki swear revenge.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok heads to Tomahawk, Wisconsin to open a Dethfair in hopes that it will stimulate the economy they destroyed. Pickles uses this time at home to reconnect with his disapproving mother who tells him that she won't respect him until he gets a real job. Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Tired of taking verbal abuse from his bandmate, Toki writes a tell-all book called Skwisgaar Is Ams Dick and takes over as Dethklok's lead guitarist. But can Toki handle the spotlight? Meanwhile, Nathan buys a new favorite toy for the band: a defibrillator.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.sub-title: METALOCALYPSE: the DOOMSTAR REQUIEM A KLOK OPERA
programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After performing a coffee jingle in the farthest reaches of the Arctic Circle to a sold-out crowd, Dethklok witnesses their French chef being chopped to pieces by the blade of their helicopter restaurant. The bad news is that Dethklok is now faced with the daunting task of cooking dinner themselves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an attempt to make their next album the most brutal ever, Dethklok commissions a Russian nuclear submarine to record deep in the Nordic waters. Underwater, the band copes with seasickness, whale and radar pings infecting their tracks, and loss of food and oxygen.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band plays a song that unintentionally wakes a deadly Nordic Forest Troll. Dethklok doesn't care until they learn that the Troll is knocking out all DSL lines, making their Internet really slow. Dethklok must write the world's first Death Metal Lullaby to put the demonic beast back to sleep.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a legendary bad move, Dethklok decides to do standup comedy. Pickles remains traumatized by a heckler while the rest of Dethklok learns that comedy is all about embracing the hate. Dethklok finds that they are very much naturals at this. The physical comedy routine they work out really kills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Uncomfortable and embarrassed, Dethklok painfully endures while their parents are in town for a visit. The guys are at first pissed and doubtful when their parents announce the release of their "Parents of Dethklok" album, but are then impressed by the depth of their parents' anger.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles reunites with his old hair band, "Snakes 'N' Barrels", which has the rest of Dethklok worried that their drummer may leave them. When the ten-years-sober "Snakes 'N' Barrels" are given experimental psychotropic drugs before their performance, the result is something beyond brutal.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has opened up their home for their annual Dethfan Day. Dethklok continues with their "normal" everyday activities (like liver transplant surgery and scrubbing toilets) while fans are ushered around the house, guided by an animated skull and a maze of velvet rope. Dethklok finds themselves in a sticky situation when two Internet geeks threaten to bring down Dethklok with their advanced Photoshopping skills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a last-ditch scramble for tax breaks, Dethklok agrees to host an event with the London Philharmonic, but only under one condition: Dethklok gets to produce their own kind of laser light show. They've also taken in a distempered fat kid they found, and must juggle the responsibilities of parenting while upholding their charitable agreement.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

Everyone is supposed to be on their best behavior, but The Monarch can't resist the temptation to wreak havoc once he finds himself inside the "belly of the beast"... nor can he find a bathroom.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When Brock and Dr. Venture are kidnapped from the funeral of a college friend, the boys enlist the aid of the original Team Venture: a group of superscience adventurers who worked for their grandfather in the sixties.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Monarch is on trial for the one crime he may not have committed, under mysterious circumstances stemming from his bitter breakup with Dr. Girlfriend. The boys and Dr. Orpheus are forced to testify, but only Brock is aware that something far more sinister is afoot.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture finally learns the secret of his recurring womb nightmares when a stomach tumor turns out to be something far more sinister.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Powerless in the Face of Death

programme.desc: Aided by Henchmen 21, 24 and a ragtag band of roughneck new recruits, The Monarch attempts to rebuild his villainous empire and rekindle his relationship with Dr. Girlfriend. A showdown at the local shopping mall forces his hand, and as he struggles to choose between revenge and reconciliation amidst a sea of violence, a wounded Brock falls into the clutches of The Phantom Limb.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When Brock is reactivated by the Office of Secret Intelligence to track down a rogue agent, he subcontracts his ex-girlfriend, the malevolently mercenary Molotov Cocktease, to protect the Venture Compound from enemies within and without. Love is in the air! Or is it... murder?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Escape To The House Of Mummies (Part 2)
programme.desc: Team Venture find themselves trapped in the clutches of a bloodthirsty Egyptian cult.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Phantom Limb and Dr. Girlfriend agree to a civil double date with The Monarch and some girl he met on the internet in order to discuss The Monarch's official re-entry into the Guild of Calamitous Intent. Doc and Brock become the unwitting pawns in a low-grade pissing contest when Phantom Limb's sics the Guild's commandos on the Venture compound to prove his dominance. Can Brock hold off an army? Can Doc escape death and finish watching the worst porno ever?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Baron Underbheit captures Team Venture when the X-1 crash lands in Underland while en route from a superscience costume party. Rather than execute them immediately, he inflicts an unspeakable torture upon them: they're forced to attend his wedding.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When the Guild of Calamitous Intent finally approves Dr. Orpheus for his very own arch nemesis he calls upon old friends The Alchemist and Jefferson Twilight to resurrect their former super-team, The Order of the Triad. While they audition supervillain candidates at the Venture Compound, a jealous Doc isn't about to let Orpheus steal the show. Let loose the Walking Eye!

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Guess Who's Coming to State Dinner
programme.desc: The mysterious blinking band aid on Bud Manstrong's head might be the key to a mystery only the ghost of Abraham Lincoln and Team Venture can solve.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Kills

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: As Phantom Limb makes his stunning power play, only Brock can rally The Monarch's forces to mount a defense. The fate of almost everyone in the Venture universe hangs in the balance as The Sovereign reveals his true identity and guys and stuff explode all over the place.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Shadowman 9: In the Cradle of Destiny

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: At long last, The Venture Bros. peels away the onion-like shrouds of time for a look back into the troubled past of America's most beloved hydrocephalic former boy genius, to reveal dark secrets that even he didn't know about. What could Pete White have been hiding from him for all these years? And why is Brock in on the cover-up?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Hate is

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Love is in the air, kind of, when Dr. Venture encounters his childhood friend, Dr. Tara Quymn, in the Amazon Rain Forest. But while Rusty puts the moves on his old play date, Hank makes a play for Dr. Quymn's twin daughters, Nancy and Drew, who in turn, only have eyes for Dean. And the Quymn's bodyguard, Ginnie, is hot for Brock. Maybe. But all of their romantic interludes will have to be put aside when the terror of the Wereodile threatens their camp.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: What Goes Down Must Come Up
programme.desc: All basements are kinda spooky, but the Ventures are about to learn the hard way that beneath the foundations of the Venture Compound lie deep, dark secrets... great and small. Only the one-two punch of magic and technology can save Doc, Brock--and perhaps the planet--from certain doom as the boys recruit The Order of the Triad and Pete White to get to the bottom of a thirty year old mystery.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Bored and under-whelmed with his new Guild-assigned arch-enemies, The Monarch seeks to re-spark his old hatred by secretly visiting the Venture Compound while Dr. Venture is away at the Science Now conference. His passion for arching all things Venture may threaten to seriously cool things with his other love, Dr. Mrs. The Monarch, but does it really count as arching when there's nobody home? Or is there?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Determined to honor the father he never knew, Jonas, Jr. converts Spider Skull Island into a Team Venture Museum. Unfortunately, he invited all of his father's surviving friends and enemies to the grand opening. There's nothing like a party to stir up decades worth of sibling rivalries, bitter regrets and half-forgotten hatreds.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Family That Slays Together, Stays Together Part I, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Family That Slays Together, Stays Together Part II, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Blood of the Father, Heart of Steel

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Hank, along with is friend, Dermott, start breaking all of the Venture Compound Rules in a bid to get his father's attention. But Dr. Venture is focused completely on Dean, who is taking his first steps in joining the family business as a Super Scientist. But someone else wants Dr. Venture's attention, too: A shadowy figure from Dr. Venture's past who is out to steal Dean's future.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the death of his best friend, Henchman 21 has rededicated his life to become the most feared and skilled of all of the Monarch's Henchmen. But tonight, all bets are off as Henchman 21 begins the hunt for the murderer of Henchman 24. Alliances shift, secrets are revealed, and the Venture brothers are kidnapped. Again.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Guild of Calamitous Intent comes under attack from an old foe with a new name, Revenge. Revenge's hunt for the all-powerful Orb brings the entire Guild to the front door of the Venture Compound, where they must face the combined might of Sgt. Hatred and Hank Venture.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Monarch makes his move on Dr. Venture, just as he's distracted by problems with zoning regulations. But how does Monstroso play in and what are his ultimate plans? And how does it all relate to Brock Samson and the mystery of Sphinx? Part of Season 4.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Diving Bell Vs. The Butter-Glider, The
programme.desc: The semi-season opener finds Dr. Venture semi-paralyzed in a trauma-induced coma. Sgt. Hatred and the boys recruit the medical minds of Conjectural Technologies for the mystery diagnosis. Meanwhile, the Monarch is over the moon about his latest gadget, but it's driving a hot wedge in his relationships with his wife and henchmen.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Hank and Dean finally graduate from their learning beds. But what's next? College? The army? Life on the outside sees the boys taking two very different career paths--and one of them leads straight to the Phantom Limb.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Somebody has been kidnapping the world's super-scientists and super-villains. But whom? And to what end? The OSI, SPHINX, The Guild of Calamitous Intent and The Revenge Society must put aside their differences and convene a secret think tank to solve a mystery of epic proportions.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: With Dean off to New York for a summer internship, Hank is forced by his father to get a job. But when the budding entrepreneur dons a fabled fedora to become a private dick, a tangled mystery of sex, lies, and dirty secrets lands right in his lap.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dean's summer internship in New York City turns deadly when he learns his new employer harbors a dark secret. Meanwhile, Doc's newfound love of show tunes makes him an easy target for the newly re-formed Revenge Society.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture isn't feeling himself lately...he's killing himself. Orpheus suspects it's an inside job and pries the Venture family from their touch football game to help him teach Doc the value of self-love.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: What's more frightening than a doll that wants to kill you with a broken bottle? What's more perilous than a car that has no brakes and is aimed at your torso? What brings more sleepless nights than the threat of chlymidia? The PROM! The Venture boys embrace societies most feared school dance in this hour long danger-pile. Will they live to look back at their rented suits with horror?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: One of Dr. Venture's old inventions seems to have gotten a mind of its own, so General Manhowers sends him to Central America to fix it. The Ventures must all confront their own hearts of darkness if they're to survive what's waiting for them in the jungle.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Henchman 21's command of Team SPHINX is starting to rub the O.S.I. the wrong way, and his new recruits are rubbing them even wronger. Meanwhile, The Monarch tries on a new face to ingratiate himself with Dr. Venture.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Every year, since he was a little boy, Dr. Venture flies to the tiny island of Spanikos for a week of fun in the Grecian sun. But this year a dangerous new enemy and a dark secret from Doc's past threaten to turn his vacation into a slay-cation.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Brock and the O.S.I. come under fire from the higher ups when they lose two high value super-criminal prisoners. Somebody helped them escape, and everyone aboard the hover-quarters is a suspect in this 22 minute potboiler - even the visiting Ventures.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: A friendship built on lies threatens to unravel Dr. Venture's sanity. But Hank and Henchman 21 are the ones getting committed to an asylum. And Dean's growing relationship with a mystery woman is only making everyone crazier.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.desc: Three high school freshmen hire a low-budget bodyguard to protect them from bullies. The man claiming to be a special ops veteran is actually a homeless con artist, but he develops genuine affection for the kids while teaching them to stand up for themselves.

programme.title: The Bachelor Weekend (The Stag)
programme.desc: An Irish groom's brother plans a hiking trip bachelor party with a no-women rule. When the groom's fiancée's brother shows up with his girlfriend, tensions arise. The weekend camping trip becomes a test of friendships, masculinity, and relationships in the wilderness.

programme.title: Mr. 3000
programme.desc: Aging baseball legend Stan Ross discovers that three of his 3,000 career hits were incorrectly counted. Nine years after retiring, the arrogant player returns to baseball at age 47 to reclaim his record and legacy while learning humility and what truly matters.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Film noir-obsessed video store clerk Neil meets and falls for Violet, a free-spirited woman who pulls him into her world of spontaneous adventures. She stages elaborate film-like scenarios to shake up his routine life, but her extreme methods test whether their romance can survive reality.

programme.title: Two Can Play That Game
programme.desc: Corporate attorney and relationship expert Shante Smith uses her rules for romance to keep her boyfriend in line. When he threatens to stray, she employs her ten-day plan to regain control, but his best friend counters with his own dating strategies in this battle of sexes.

programme.title: My Boss's Daughter
programme.desc: Tom accepts his boss's request to house-sit, hoping to get close to his boss's daughter whom he has a crush on. The evening spirals into disaster as parties, drugs, escaped animals, and unexpected guests turn his romantic opportunity into total chaos.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: To escape neighborhood bully Deebo, Craig moves to the suburbs to live with his uncle and cousin Day-Day. What should be a peaceful change becomes complicated when they encounter new troubles including thieves, romantic interests, and neighborhood conflicts in Rancho Cucamonga.
